title: CowrieEvent
description: One Cowrie JSON log line as accepted by POST /ingest and POST /ingest/batch. Only the fields the API uses are listed; unknown fields are allowed and kept in raw_events. The backend (app/routers/ingest.py, class CowrieEvent) is authoritative; this schema is a coarse screen. Free-text fields are attacker-controlled; the API truncates them to 4096 characters.

session.description: Without a session id the event is stored in raw_events only.

src_ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6. The API normalises it with Python's ipaddress and rejects anything else with 422.

protocol.description: Stored as 'ssh' or 'telnet'; anything else becomes 'ssh'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601. Missing -> server receive time. No offset -> treated as UTC.

duration_ms.description: Milliseconds (newer Cowrie). The API stores duration_ms/1000 as duration_seconds.
